name: Pork & Edamame Fried Rice
subtitle: Uses the banked pork shoulder and freezer vegetables
before: **Rice cooked and cold:** 1 cup dry jasmine + 1¼ cups water → ~3 cups, spread thin and chilled uncovered 30+ min.
Pork bag thawed in the fridge.
notes: Stir-fries move too fast to prep mid-cook, so everything is staged before the pan heats.

items: 1 small bag pork shoulder, thawed (10–16 oz)
3 eggs (4 if pork is under 12 oz) + pinch salt
½ tsp white or black pepper

steps.title: Thaw the vegetables
steps.body: Microwave **1 bag stir-fry vegetables + 1½ cups edamame** for **2–3 min**, just until thawed. Drain and blot dry on a towel.

steps.title: Prep the rest
steps.body: Tear the **pork** into bite-size pieces. Beat **3 eggs** with a **pinch of salt**. Slice **4 scallions** (whites and greens separate). Mince **4 cloves garlic** and grate **1 Tbsp ginger** into the scallion whites.

steps.title: Mix the sauce
steps.body: Stir **2 Tbsp soy + 1 Tbsp oyster sauce + ½ tsp sugar + ½ tsp pepper** in a cup. Set **1 tsp sesame oil** aside.

steps.title: Crisp the pork
steps.body: Dry 12-inch skillet over **medium-high**. Pork in one layer, **3–4 min** untouched, toss, **2 min** more. Move to a plate; leave the fat in the pan.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.body: Add **1 tsp neutral oil** if the pan is dry. Scramble the eggs into soft curds, **~1 min**. Onto the plate with the pork.

steps.title: Aromatics
steps.body: Heat to **high**. Add the **remaining neutral oil (~2 tsp)** and the **scallion whites, garlic and ginger**. Stir **30 sec**.

steps.title: Vegetables
steps.body: Add the **stir-fry vegetables and edamame**. Stir-fry **2–3 min** until hot and dry.

steps.title: Rice
steps.body: Add **3 cups cold rice**. Press flat, leave **1 min**, toss. Repeat 3–4 times, **~4 min** total.

steps.title: Sauce and finish
steps.body: Pour the sauce around the **edge** of the pan and toss. Return the pork and eggs, toss **1 min**. Off heat: **1 tsp sesame oil** and the scallion greens. Taste; add soy **½ tsp** at a time if needed.

after: Serve 2 portions; the bigger one goes to whoever has the higher protein target.

macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number. Assumes 12 oz pork shoulder. This is a big plate; the pork shoulder is this week's fattier protein.
